[[File:Middle-earth The Wizards original rulebook logo.png|thumb|Original Middle-earth: The Wizards CCG game logo.]]
'''Middle-earth Collectible Card Game''' is a collectible card game based on J. R. R. Tolkien's Middle-earth, first published by Iron Crown Enterprises in late 1995 as ''Middle-earth: The Wizards''. Coleman Charlton designed the base game, and Charlton and Mike Reynolds led its development.<ref name="rules">[https://www.vintageccg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Middle-Earth-The-Wizards-CCG-Rulesbook.pdf Middle-earth: The Wizards rulesbook], Iron Crown Enterprises, credits. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230630191435/https://www.vintageccg.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Middle-Earth-The-Wizards-CCG-Rulesbook.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="council">[https://meccg.com/the-game/ The Game], Council of Elrond. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260210221811/https://meccg.com/the-game/ Internet Archive].</ref>

== Gameplay ==

Players represent rival wizards, assemble companies, and travel across Middle-earth to gather resources and allies. Players also use hazard cards to interfere with rival companies. Expansions introduced roles such as Ringwraiths and the Balrog.<ref name="rules" /><ref name="council" />

== Publication ==

''The Balrog'', the last published expansion, appeared in 1998. Iron Crown Enterprises announced that it had ceased production and sale of its Middle-earth products and stopped filling orders on 22 September 1999.<ref name="council" /><ref>[https://www.theonering.net/torwp/1999/09/22/22047-what-on-middle-earth-is-going-on/ ICE Ceases the Production and Sale of Middle-earth Products], Iron Crown Enterprises statement, 21 September 1999, reproduced by TheOneRing.net. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260611172039/https://www.theonering.net/torwp/1999/09/22/22047-what-on-middle-earth-is-going-on/ Internet Archive].</ref>

== Online play ==

The [[TCGMix]] playtest covers the original ''The Wizards'' set.<ref name="catalog" />

Players can [https://tcgmix.com/meccg/ open the game on TCGMix].<ref name="tcgmix-play-middle-earth-the-wizards-ccg">[https://tcgmix.com/meccg/ Play Middle-earth: The Wizards CCG], TCGMix. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261107194824/https://tcgmix.com/meccg/ Internet Archive].</ref>
